extracted_decision.rationale: Absolute path leaks OS username even when the story is cleared for public.
extracted_decision.summary: Public-default secret handling: record only repo display name (active_root), never absolute path; full path stays in local stderr only.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Slightly less precise provenance in exchange for no username leak.

verbatim_quote.english_translation: This story explicitly marks the repo public — public-default applies. The full absolute path WILL NOT be included in any record — active_root stores only the repo display name; the full path appears only in local stderr.
